# El Hana Group - Sharm El Sheikh Tours & Safari

> El Hana Group is South Sinai's premier licensed tour operator based in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt. Offering desert safaris, ATV quad biking, dune buggies, Bedouin sunset dinners, VIP private yachts to Ras Mohammed and White Island, scuba diving, and private airport transfers.

## Key Experiences & Services

- [ATV Quad Bike Safari](https://www.elahanasafari.com/atv-tours): 250cc desert quad excursions through Echo Valley and Sinai canyons.
- [Dune Buggy Adventure](https://www.elahanasafari.com/buggy-tours): High-performance off-road desert buggy tours.
- [Ras Mohammed & White Island Yacht](https://www.elahanasafari.com/sea-trips): VIP luxury yacht cruises with guided snorkeling and fresh seafood lunch.
- [Bedouin Dinner & Stargazing](https://www.elahanasafari.com/bedouin-experience): Authentic Bedouin hospitality, traditional fresh bread, and telescope astronomy.
- [Dahab & Blue Hole Day Trip](https://www.elahanasafari.com/excursions): Full day coastal tour, camel riding, and world-class snorkeling.
- [Introductory Scuba Diving](https://www.elahanasafari.com/diving): 1-on-1 certified PADI diving instructors in the Red Sea.
- [Airport & Hotel Transfers](https://www.elahanasafari.com/transfers): 24/7 private air-conditioned shuttles to all Sharm El Sheikh hotels.
- [All Experiences Catalog](https://www.elahanasafari.com/experiences): Complete list of excursions with instant WhatsApp booking.
